snippet.title: Interlude: Open beta trailer
snippet.description:
Interlude (also known as Yet Another Vertically Scrolling Rhythm Game) is a free-to-play keyboard rhythm game. 
It started as a personal client where I just incrementally make improvements and fixes when I get the time, but the longer I do that, the more it's shaping up to be a game I could release to the world!

Visit https://www.yavsrg.net/ to download the game, join the discord and more!

Today marks the day I begin making announcements about it to get some extra interest in the game, as bug reports and feedback are the reason it's come this far already.

It's an open beta so the game is still being developed (some areas still definitely need it), but it's already a comfortable client for your VSRG gaming needs!
This also means Interlude is in a very versatile state - Your contributions could make a big impact on how this game turns out!

Thank you to everyone who has been playing and supporting the game so far, without you it would never have made it to this stage of development
----

Background song: Netrum - Kinetic
https://soundcloud.com/netrumsounds/netrum-kinetic
